app.name: Persona Platform
app.tagline: Create an AI persona that answers in your style and share it by link

auth.signInRequired: Sign in to use the studio

studio.title: My personas
studio.empty: No personas yet — create your first one

persona.displayNameHint: Your name or nickname, e.g. Boss
persona.slugHint: Letters a-z, digits and - only. Leave empty for a random one

settings.title: Answering style
settings.writingStyleHint: e.g. loves comparisons, uses → to map terms
settings.rulesHint: e.g. always end with สรุป:

examplesTab.title: Question → answer examples
examplesTab.hint: The more real examples, the more the persona sounds like you. Aim for at least 5; at least 3 public examples are needed to publish.
examplesTab.warning: No passwords, API keys, confidential company data, or other people's messages (chat logs usually contain them — this matters under PDPA). Private examples are only used when you test the persona yourself.
examplesTab.question: Question
examplesTab.privateHint: Private = never used to answer visitors

persona.newVersionNotice: This persona is published. Edits create a new draft version; the shared link keeps using the published version until you publish again.

compile.hint: Compile to build the style card, tag question shapes, and pick fixed examples. Do it after every edit.
compile.noStyleCard: No style card yet — compile first

test.hint: Testing as the owner: all examples are used, including private ones (visitors only get public ones)

publish.hint: Publish the latest compiled version. Visitors chat with it until you publish again.
publish.needPublic: At least 3 public examples are required (you have {n}) — visitors only ever see public examples
publish.visibilityHint: Unlisted = anyone with the link / Public = discoverable later

chat.placeholder: Type a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.networkError: Could not connect. Please try again.

public.label: AI version of {name}
public.disclaimer: This is an AI imitating an answering style, not the real person. It can be wrong and does not know their personal life.
public.ownerCanRead: The persona owner can read this conversation
public.ownerCannotRead: The persona owner only sees aggregate stats, not your messages
